The numbers don’t lie—Medicaid’s collapse is fueled by both bureaucratic bloat and systemic abuse. CMS just exposed how states like California tax Medicaid managed care at $274 per member/month while charging non-Medicaid plans $2, laundering federal dollars to bankroll coverage for 1.6 million illegal immigrants.

The One Big Beautiful Bill’s citizenship checks are a start, but Section 3’s loopholes let states hide behind “emergency services” mandates. Real reform means recouping the $30 billion in stolen funds and ending this two-tiered system where citizens wait in line behind those who broke the law to jump the queue.

No more shell games—defund the fraud, enforce the border, prioritize taxpayers.
